author: Kushal
problem: lanes lists (people waiting, lane name) for a supermarket's open checkouts, ordered from the entrance (at least one lane). Return the name of the lane with the fewest people waiting, picking the one nearest the entrance if several tie.
bug_description: Uses min(lanes) without a key, so ties on the queue length are broken by comparing lane names instead of keeping the lane nearest the entrance.

comments.accurate: Returns the lane with the shortest queue
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the lane with the shortest queue, going by lane name when queues are equal
comments.wrong_location: Queue comparison verified; lanes with nobody waiting may be skipped
